name: technical-seo
title: Technical SEO
description: Check and implement title tags, meta descriptions, headings, canonicals, robots, sitemap, internal linking, structured data and image alt text.
instructions: Titles 30-60 chars, descriptions 70-160, unique per page; one h1; logical heading order.
Valid JSON-LD with appropriate types; no invented ratings/reviews in schema.
Canonical, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, descriptive internal anchors, alt text on meaningful images.
